literal: Taizu, Part Two
idiomatic: Taizu, Part Two

literal: In the fourth year, on bingchen day in the first month of spring, he hunted tigers on Eastern Mountain.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, on bingchen day in the first month of spring, he hunted tigers on Eastern Mountain.

literal: In the second month, on bingyin day, he restored the old city of Liaoyang, filled it with Han and Bohai households, renamed it Dongping Commandery, and established a Defense Commissioner.
idiomatic: In the second month, on bingyin day, he rebuilt the old city of Liaoyang, settled it with Han and Bohai households, renamed it Dongping Commandery, and appointed a Defense Commissioner.

literal: In the fifth month of summer, on gengchen day, he returned from Dongping Commandery.
idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on gengchen day, he returned from Dongping Commandery.

literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on dingyou day, he visited Confucius's temple and ordered the Empress and Crown Prince each to visit temples and monasteries separately.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on dingyou day, he paid homage at Confucius's temple and ordered the Empress and Crown Prince to visit temples and monasteries in turn.

literal: In the ninth month, while campaigning against the Wugu tribe, he heard on the road that the Empress Dowager was ill; in one day he rode six hundred li back, attended the Empress Dowager, and after her illness abated, returned to the army.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, while marching against the Wugu tribe, he learned on the road that the Empress Dowager was ill. He rode six hundred li in a single day to attend her; when she recovered, he returned to the army.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on bingwu day, he halted among the Wugu; a great wind and snowstorm blew, and the army could not advance; the Emperor prayed to Heaven, and in a moment the sky cleared.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on bingwu day, he encamped among the Wugu. A fierce blizzard blocked the army's advance; the Emperor prayed to Heaven, and within moments the sky cleared.

literal: He ordered the Crown Prince to lead the vanguard in attack; they broke the enemy and took fourteen thousand two hundred captives, and more than two hundred thousand oxen, horses, carts, tents, and implements.
idiomatic: He ordered the Crown Prince to lead the vanguard forward; they routed the enemy, taking fourteen thousand two hundred captives and more than two hundred thousand oxen, horses, carts, tents, and goods.

literal: From this time the whole tribe came to submit.
idiomatic: From that time the entire tribe submitted.

literal: In the fifth year, on yichou day in the first month of spring, he first devised the Khitan large script.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, on yichou day in the first month of spring, he first created the Khitan large script.

literal: In the fifth month of summer, on bingyin day, the King of Wuyue again sent Teng Yanxiu with tribute of rhinoceros horn and coral; offices were conferred on him and he was sent away.
idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on bingyin day, the King of Wuyue again dispatched Teng Yanxiu with rhinoceros horn and coral as tribute; he was granted an office and sent home.

literal: On gengchen day, a dragon was seen in the waters south of Zhaila Mountain; the Emperor shot and captured it and stored its bones in the imperial vault.
idiomatic: On gengchen day a dragon appeared in the waters south of Zhaila Mountain; the Emperor shot and killed it and had its bones stored in the inner treasury.

literal: In the intercalary sixth month, on dingmao day, his younger brother Su was made tixin, and Kang Moj was made yilijin bil.
idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, on dingmao day, his younger brother Su was made tixin, and Kang Moj was made yilijin bil.

literal: On the jiwei new moon in the eighth month of autumn, the Xiang tribes rebelled.
idiomatic: On the jiwei new moon in the eighth month of autumn, the Xiang tribes rose in revolt.

literal: On xinwei day, the Emperor personally led a campaign.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the Emperor took the field in person.

literal: On the jichou new moon in the ninth month, Liang sent Lang Gongyuan on a diplomatic mission.
idiomatic: On the jichou new moon in the ninth month, Liang dispatched Lang Gongyuan on a diplomatic visit.

literal: On renyin day, the large script was completed and an edict ordered its promulgation.
idiomatic: On renyin day the large script was finished, and an edict ordered it promulgated throughout the realm.

literal: The Crown Prince led Diela branch chiefs including Wuli Zhen and others on raids through Yunnei and Tiande.
idiomatic: The Crown Prince led Diela branch chiefs including Wuli Zhen and others in raids across Yunnei and Tiande.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinwei day, they attacked Tiande.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on xinwei day, they attacked Tiande.

literal: On guiyou day, Military Governor Song Yao surrendered; he was given bow and arrows, saddle and horse, and banners and drums, and his army was renamed Yingtian.
idiomatic: On guiyou day Military Governor Song Yao surrendered; he was granted bow and arrows, saddle and horse, banners and drums, and his force was renamed the Yingtian Army.

literal: On jiaxu day, the army withdrew.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day the army withdrew.

literal: Song Yao rebelled again.
idiomatic: Song Yao rebelled once more.

literal: On bingzi day, they stormed the city, captured Song Yao, took his family prisoner, and moved the people south of the Yin Mountains.
idiomatic: On bingzi day they stormed the city, seized Song Yao, took his household captive, and resettled the populace south of the Yin Mountains.

literal: On jiwei day in the twelfth month, the army returned.
idiomatic: On jiwei day in the twelfth month the army returned.

literal: In the sixth year, on bingwu day in the first month of spring, his younger brother Su was made Southern Chancellor, and Dieli was made tixin.
idiomatic: In the sixth year, on bingwu day in the first month of spring, his younger brother Su was made Southern Chancellor, and Dieli was made tixin.

literal: The Southern Chancellor post had been vacant for a long time since the chaos among the brothers, which had brought calamity to many leading families of the prefecture, so Chiefs of the Chudem tribe Zagdeli and Zhiligu had been overseeing it.
idiomatic: The Southern Chancellorship had long stood empty: after the brothers' rebellion had ruined many great families of the prefecture, Zagdeli and Zhiligu of the Chudem tribe had held the office in trust.

literal: The prefecture repeatedly requested selecting someone from the imperial clan, but the Emperor said the old system could not be rashly changed.
idiomatic: The prefecture repeatedly petitioned that a member of the imperial clan be chosen, but the Emperor held that the old institution must not be altered lightly.

literal: When the petitions continued without cease, he reported to the ancestral temple before conferring the appointment.
idiomatic: When the petitions would not cease, he announced the matter at the ancestral temple before granting the appointment.

literal: Imperial clan members as Southern Chancellor began from this time.
idiomatic: From this time members of the imperial clan served as Southern Chancellor.

literal: On the bingxu new moon in the fifth month of summer, an edict fixed the laws and regularized court ranks.
idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon in the fifth month of summer, an edict established the laws and set court ranks in order.

literal: On bingshen day, an edict ordered portraits of upright ministers of past dynasties painted as the Recruitment for Remonstrance chart, and that prefectural officials in each of the four seasonal months inquire into the people's welfare and ills.
idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict ordered portraits of upright ministers of former ages painted as the Recruitment for Remonstrance chart, and that local officials in each of the four seasonal months inquire into the people's hardships and needs.

literal: On the yimao new moon in the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the yimao new moon in the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the guichou new moon, Wang Yu, Defense Commissioner of Jin's Xinzhou, submitted with his armies and horses from north of the mountains.
idiomatic: That winter, on the guichou new moon of the tenth month, Wang Yu, Defense Commissioner of Jin's Xinzhou, defected with his troops and horses from north of the mountains.

literal: On bingzi day, the Emperor led a great army through Juyong Pass.
idiomatic: On bingzi day the Emperor led a great army through Juyong Pass.

literal: In the eleventh month, on guimao day, they descended through the ancient northern pass.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guimao day, they passed down through the ancient northern gate.

literal: On dingwei day, detachments were sent to raid more than ten cities including Tan, Shun, Anyuan, Sanhe, Liangxiang, Wangdu, Lu, Mancheng, Suicheng, and others; captives were taken and the people moved into the interior.
idiomatic: On dingwei day detachments were sent to overrun more than ten cities—Tan, Shun, Anyuan, Sanhe, Liangxiang, Wangdu, Lu, Mancheng, Suicheng, and others—taking captives and resettling the people in the interior.

literal: On guichou day in the twelfth month, Wang Yu came to court with his followers; the Emperor called Yu "son," rewarded him lavishly, and moved his people south of the Huang River.
idiomatic: On guichou day in the twelfth month Wang Yu came to court with his followers; the Emperor called him "son," heaped gifts upon him, and resettled his people south of the Huang River.

literal: On gengshen day, the Crown Prince led Wang Yu on raids in Dingzhou, while Kang Moj attacked Changlu.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the Crown Prince led Wang Yu in raids around Dingzhou, while Kang Moj attacked Changlu.

literal: Wang Chuzhi, Military Governor of Tang's Yiwu Army, was imprisoned by his adopted son Du, who <1> proclaimed himself acting governor.
idiomatic: Wang Chuzhi, Military Governor of Tang's Yiwu Army, was imprisoned by his adopted son Du, who <1> declared himself acting governor.

literal: On guihai day, they besieged Zhuozhou; a white hare climbed the ramparts, and that day they broke the outer city.
idiomatic: On guihai day they besieged Zhuozhou; a white hare scaled the walls, and that same day they stormed the outer city.

literal: On guiyou day, Prefect Li Sibi surrendered the city.
idiomatic: On guiyou day Prefect Li Sibi surrendered the city.

literal: On yihai day, Li Cun reached Dingzhou, and Wang Du came out to greet him before his horse.
idiomatic: On yihai day Li Cun reached Dingzhou, and Wang Du came out to greet him at his horse's head.

literal: Cun marched toward Wangdu, encountered five thousand of our cavalry weakened by hunger, surrounded them, fought fiercely four times, but could not break free.
idiomatic: Cun pressed toward Wangdu and met five thousand of our horsemen, gaunt with hunger; he surrounded them and fought four fierce engagements but could not break the encirclement.

literal: Li Sizhao led three hundred horsemen to the rescue; our forces briefly withdrew, and Cun was able to escape; in the great battle that followed our army was at a disadvantage and withdrew.
idiomatic: Li Sizhao led three hundred horsemen to the rescue; our forces fell back slightly, and Cun broke free; in the great battle that followed our army was worsted and withdrew.

literal: When Cun reached Youzhou, he sent two hundred horsemen to follow our army; we counterattacked and captured them all.
idiomatic: When Cun reached Youzhou he sent two hundred horsemen to trail our army; we turned and struck, capturing every man.

literal: On jimao day, returning we halted at Tanzhou; men from You came to attack; we drove them off and captured their assistant general.
idiomatic: On jimao day, on the return march we halted at Tanzhou; men from You came to attack; we drove them off and took their assistant general prisoner.

literal: An edict moved the people of Tan and Shun to Dongping and Shen Prefecture.
idiomatic: An edict resettled the people of Tan and Shun in Dongping and Shen Prefecture.

literal: In the first year of Tianzan, on gengshen day in the second month of spring, he again raided the You and Ji region.
idiomatic: In the first year of Tianzan, on gengshen day in the second month of spring, he again overran the You and Ji region.

literal: On guiyou day, an edict changed the era name and pardoned offenses below capital crimes committed before the army.
idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict changed the era name and granted amnesty for offenses short of capital crimes to all who had marched with the army.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin day, they attacked Jizhou.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin day, they attacked Jizhou.

literal: On wuwu day, they stormed it, captured Prefect Hu Qiong, and put Lu Guoyong and Nielu Gu in charge of military affairs.
idiomatic: On wuwu day they stormed it, took Prefect Hu Qiong prisoner, and put Lu Guoyong and Nielu Gu in charge of military affairs.

literal: On renxu day, he feasted the soldiers on a grand scale.
idiomatic: On renxu day he held a great feast for the troops.

literal: On guihai day, Li Cun besieged Zhenzhou; Zhang Wenli requested aid, and Langjun Dielie and General Kang Modan were sent to strike them, defeated them, and killed their general Li Sizhao.
idiomatic: On guihai day Li Cun besieged Zhenzhou; Zhang Wenli sought relief, and Langjun Dielie and General Kang Modan were dispatched against him; they routed the enemy and killed their general Li Sizhao.

literal: On xinwei day, they attacked Shicheng County and stormed it.
idiomatic: On xinwei day they attacked Shicheng County and took it by storm.

literal: In the fifth month, on dingwei day, Zhang Wenli died; his son Chujin sent envoys bearing a memorial of thanks.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei day, Zhang Wenli died; his son Chujin sent envoys with a memorial of gratitude.

literal: In the sixth month, the Eagle Army was dispatched to attack tribes in the southwest; the captives taken were given to the poor.
idiomatic: In the sixth month the Eagle Army was sent against tribes in the southwest; the captives taken were distributed to the poor.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi day, Xiao Xiade was made Northern Chancellor.
idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on jiazi day, Xiao Xiade was made Northern Chancellor.

literal: The Diela tribe was divided into two divisions: Xie Niechi was made Northern Division yilijin, Wansi was made Southern Division yilijin; an edict split the Great Northern Nongwu into two tribes and established two Military Governors to command them.
idiomatic: The Diela tribe was divided into two divisions: Xie Niechi was made Northern Division yilijin and Wansi Southern Division yilijin; an edict split the Great Northern Nongwu into two tribes and set two Military Governors over them.

literal: In the eleventh month, on renyin day, the Emperor appointed Prince Yaogu Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses to raid north of Ji.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renyin day, the Emperor named Prince Yaogu Grand Marshal of All Armies and Horses and sent him to overrun the country north of Ji.

literal: In the second year, on bingchen day in the first month of spring, Grand Marshal Yaogu captured Pingzhou, taking Prefect Zhao Siwen and Assistant General Zhang Chong.
idiomatic: In the second year, on bingchen day in the first month of spring, Grand Marshal Yaogu took Pingzhou, capturing Prefect Zhao Siwen and Assistant General Zhang Chong.

literal: In the second month, he went to Pingzhou.
idiomatic: In the second month he proceeded to Pingzhou.

literal: On jiazi day, Pingzhou was made the Lulong Army and a Military Governor was installed.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Pingzhou was made the Lulong Army and a Military Governor was appointed.

literal: On wuyin day in the third month, the army camped at Arrow Mountain to campaign against the rebel Xi chief Husun; he was captured and shot with ghost arrows.
idiomatic: On wuyin day in the third month the army encamped at Arrow Mountain to suppress the rebel Xi chief Husun; he was taken and executed with ghost arrows.

literal: Three hundred of his followers were executed and thrown into Gou River.
idiomatic: Three hundred of his followers were put to death and cast into Gou River.

literal: The Xi Duigui tribe was established, with Boluen appointed to oversee its affairs on a provisional basis.
idiomatic: The Xi Duigui tribe was established, with Boluen provisionally placed in overall charge.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou day, Liang sent envoys on a diplomatic mission, and the King of Wuyue sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou day, Liang sent envoys on a diplomatic visit, and the King of Wuyue sent envoys bearing tribute.

literal: On guichou day, Yaogu was ordered to attack Youzhou, and Diela branch yilijin Dilie raided Shanxi territory.
idiomatic: On guichou day Yaogu was ordered to attack Youzhou, while Diela branch yilijin Dilie overran the Shanxi region.

literal: On gengshen day, Yaogu's army reached east of Youzhou; Military Governor Fu Cunshen sent men out to fight; they were defeated, and General Pei Xin and his son were captured.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Yaogu's army reached east of Youzhou; Military Governor Fu Cunshen sent troops out to give battle; they were beaten, and General Pei Xin and his son were taken prisoner.

literal: In the intercalary month, on gengchen day, Yaogu reached Zhenzhou.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengchen day, Yaogu reached Zhenzhou.

literal: On renwu day, they stormed Quyang.
idiomatic: On renwu day they stormed Quyang.

literal: On bingxu day, they captured Beiping.
idiomatic: On bingxu day they took Beiping.

literal: That month, Jin King Li Cun assumed the imperial throne and took Tang as his dynastic name.
idiomatic: That month Jin King Li Cun ascended the throne and proclaimed the dynastic name Tang.

literal: In the fifth month, on wuwu day, Yaogu's army returned.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuwu day, Yaogu's army returned.

literal: On guihai day, he feasted the soldiers on a grand scale, with rewards in varying measure.
idiomatic: On guihai day he held a great feast for the troops, distributing rewards in due measure.

literal: In the sixth month, on xinchou day, Persia sent tribute.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinchou day, Persia sent tribute.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, former Northern Chancellor Xiao Aguzhi and Wang Yu raided the Yan and Zhao region.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn former Northern Chancellor Xiao Aguzhi and Wang Yu overran the Yan and Zhao region.

literal: On the xinwei new moon in the tenth month of winter, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon in the tenth month of winter there was a solar eclipse.

literal: On jimao day, Tang forces destroyed Liang.
idiomatic: On jimao day Tang forces destroyed Liang.

literal: In the third year, in the first month of spring, troops were dispatched to raid south of Yan.
idiomatic: In the third year, in the first month of spring, troops were sent to overrun the country south of Yan.

literal: In the fifth month of summer, on bingwu day, tixin Dieli was made Southern Division yilijin.
idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on bingwu day, tixin Dieli was made Southern Division yilijin.

literal: That month, the people of Jizhou were moved to populate Liaozhou territory.
idiomatic: That month the people of Jizhou were resettled to fill Liaozhou territory.

literal: Bohai killed its prefect Zhang Xiushi and plundered its people.
idiomatic: Bohai killed its prefect Zhang Xiushi and carried off its people.

literal: On yiyou day in the sixth month, the Emperor summoned the Empress, Crown Prince, Grand Marshal, the two Chancellors, and chiefs of the various tribes and addressed an edict, saying:
idiomatic: On yiyou day in the sixth month the Emperor summoned the Empress, Crown Prince, Grand Marshal, the two Chancellors, and chiefs of the various tribes and proclaimed an edict, saying:

literal: "Heaven above sends its watch, blessing the people.
idiomatic: "Heaven above keeps watch and bestows its grace upon the people.

literal: A sage sovereign and enlightened king — once in ten thousand generations.
idiomatic: A sage sovereign and enlightened king comes but once in ten thousand generations.

literal: I have received Heaven's mandate above and rule all living beings below; in every campaign I follow Heaven's will.
idiomatic: I have received Heaven's mandate above and govern all living beings below; in every campaign I act in accord with Heaven's intent.

literal: Therefore strategy rests in my own hand, and what I take or leave is as if divinely ordered; once the nation's commands are issued, hearts everywhere attach.
idiomatic: Thus strategy rests in my own hand, and what I choose or set aside is decided as by a god; once the nation's commands go forth, the people's hearts rally to me.

literal: Errors are set right, and far and near alike are without fault.
idiomatic: Wrong is made right, and far and near alike stand without reproach.

literal: One may say I embrace the breadth of the dark sea and hold steady as Mount Tai!
idiomatic: Truly I may be said to hold within me the vast dark sea and stand firm as Mount Tai!

literal: Since founding our state, we have been parent to all regions.
idiomatic: From the founding of our state we have been parent to every quarter.

literal: With law and charter established, what worry for heirs?
idiomatic: With law and charter in place, what need to fear for heirs?

literal: Ascent and descent have their appointed time; coming and going lie in my hand.
idiomatic: Rising and falling have their appointed season; departure and return rest in my hand.

literal: A wise plan and sacred assembly — surely there is accord between Heaven and man;
idiomatic: A wise design and a sacred convergence — surely Heaven and man are already in accord;

literal: the kings of many lands — could they transform their common bones?
idiomatic: the kings of many lands — can they alter bones of common clay?

literal: Three years hence, in the year bingxu, at the start of autumn, there will surely be a place of return.
idiomatic: Three years hence, in the bingxu year, at the opening of autumn, there will surely be a place to which I return.

literal: Yet have I not fulfilled two undertakings — could I fail the sincerity of kin?
idiomatic: Yet two tasks remain unfinished — how could I betray the sincerity of kin?

literal: The sun and moon are not far; let preparations be swift.
idiomatic: The sun and moon are not distant; let preparations be made in haste.

literal: " All who heard the edict were alarmed and afraid, and none understood its meaning.
idiomatic: " All who heard the edict were struck with fear, and none could fathom its meaning.

literal: That day, a great campaign was launched against the Tuyuhun, Xiang, Zubu, and other tribes.
idiomatic: That same day a great campaign was launched against the Tuyuhun, Xiang, Zubu, and other tribes.
